title: Email/set: id can appear in both updated and notUpdated when patch has both mailboxIds and keywords
description: server.rs Email/set calls handle_email_set() then handle_keyword_update() on the same update_map independently. A patch with both mailboxIds and keywords causes the id to land in notUpdated (from handle_email_set) and updated (from handle_keyword_update). RFC 8620 §5.3 forbids an id from appearing in both.
